descriptions.notStarted: Keol, the pompous working partner of Meren who is as irritable as they come in all of Maple, has a special order for me to process. Better go see what it is.
descriptions.inProgress: The moment Keol saw me walk in, he let me have it. That's because a very important order came from Abdullah VIII, and Meren decided to let me take care of it! Wow... I didn't know Meren had that much faith in me. Anyway, since Keol seems very upset over this, I'll have to go make the delivery myself.\n\n#i4001186# #t4001186# #b#c4001186# / 1
descriptions.completed: The moment Keol saw me walk in, he let me have it. That's because a very important order came from Abdullah VIII, and Meren decided to let me take care of it! Wow... I didn't know Meren had that much faith in me. Anyway, since Keol seemed way too upset to go, I had to go make the delivery myself.
